cache: common ResNet family study input cache, N=10000 (two-day plan 2026-11-22)
indices: arange(0, n) of the train array (first n, stored order)

preprocessing.repr: ImageClassification(     crop_size=[224]     resize_size=[232]     mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]     std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]     interpolation=InterpolationMode.BILINEAR )
preprocessing.pipeline: uint8 -> float/255 -> NCHW -> transforms (resize 232, center-crop 224, ImageNet mean/std) -> float64 full-net eval forward

storage.rationale: 10000 x 1024 x 14 x 14 fp32 = 8.0 GB on disk (fp64 would be 16 GB); consumers use the fp64-read path (resnet_common_lib.open_xin/xin_chunk) and form all operators in float64. The fp32 file is the defined study input; see rounding_effect for the (recorded) difference to the unrounded fp64 forward.
storage.forward_dtype: float64 (full net and local layer4+fc path)

rounding_effect.note: fp64 local forward from fp32-stored X_in vs fp64 full-network forward (unrounded): pure fp32-storage rounding effect; the cache DEFINES the study input, so ref_logits_local_fp64 is the base reference for all common-study measurements
